findings.evidence: "You record the stipend item on the request form. Finance reconciles the stipend item against the request log each month. Payroll releases the stipend item amount after that monthly review. Also, you submit the request in the portal. You track its status there until the payment clears."
findings.fix: Rewrite using consistent third person throughout: "Employees record the stipend item on the request form. Finance reconciles the stipend item against the request log each month. Payroll releases the stipend item amount after that monthly review. Employees submit the request in the portal and track its status there until the payment clears."
findings.violation: The section shifts inconsistently between second person ("You/you") and third person ("Finance," "Payroll"), creating confusion about perspective.

findings.evidence: "Completing the request begins with confirming eligibility, and uploading the receipt."
findings.fix: Remove the comma before "and" and expand to include all required steps: "Completing the request begins with confirming eligibility, uploading the receipt, submitting the manager's approval form, and submitting the original purchase order."
findings.violation: The comma before "and" is grammatically incorrect when connecting only two items, and the steps listed are incomplete compared to the requirements listed in How to Apply.

findings.evidence: "Similarly, the policy applies to one device per category per employee whenever the benefits team confirms that the role genuinely requires a second device because fieldwork regularly takes the employee away from the single fixed desk that the standard equipment list assumes every applicant has for the whole benefit year while the finance office tracks the second device against the same annual amount that the equipment catalog publishes for each category."
findings.fix: Break into shorter sentences: "The policy typically allows one device per category per employee. An exception may apply if the benefits team confirms that a role genuinely requires a second device due to regular fieldwork. The finance office tracks any second device against the same annual amount published in the equipment catalog for that category."
findings.location: Restrictions and Exceptions section, second paragraph
findings.violation: This 97-word sentence contains multiple nested clauses making it extremely difficult to parse and understand the actual policy.

findings.evidence: "The applicant must keep the equipment in good working condition and this office may ask for a brief photo check once a year."
findings.fix: Replace "this office" with the specific office name: "The applicant must keep the equipment in good working condition, and the benefits team may request a brief photo check once a year."
findings.location: Restrictions and Exceptions section, first paragraph
findings.violation: The phrase "this office" is vague and unclear about which specific office will conduct the photo check.
